column3: With respect to the Holiday Inn St. Petersburg West Mortgage Loan (2.2%), one of the non-recourse carveout guarantors, Hardik Patel, is being sued by Marriott International, Inc. for payment of a $2,000,000 arbitration award made in January 2025 arising from the non-payment of amounts due under a franchise agreement relating to a Four Points by Sheraton Hotel in Cleveland, Ohio, of which Mr. Patel was the guarantor. According to the allegations in the complaint, the franchisee of such hotel early on began missing payments under its franchise agreement, and eventually transferred the hotel to its lender in lieu of foreclosure, while executing a termination agreement whereby it agreed to pay certain amounts to the franchisor, which remain unpaid. The borrower has informed the lender that settlement negotiations are ongoing. There can be no assurance that a settlement will be entered into.
